text:
Priya: quick handoff — pushed small routing tweak to route-policy for /v2/stream to prefer pool-b for high-prio tenants at 00:30 UTC. will monitor.
Sam: saw a slight uptick 429s around 00:40, could be coldstarts or the new weight. digging.
Liam: @Sam can you drop the exact curl you used? I want to repro load.
Sam: sure —
```bash
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://gateway.internal/v2/stream" -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
```
Jorge: fwiw metrics show most 429s hit edge-lb before the route. 95th latency went 120ms->350ms for a subset.
Priya: hmm okay. @Maya any deploy-bot signals?
deploy-bot: can add
deploy-bot: Canary rollout completed: route-policy v3 -> 20% -> success. No runtime errors.
Maya: no crash logs, but opencensus traces show repeated auth lookup failures and retries for ~3% of calls — KID rotation maybe?
Liam: that matches a token-cache eviction bug I hit earlier in local. PR open: #4321. It nullifies cache under memory pressure and causes extra auth calls -> transient 429s under burst.
Priya: can we patch/rollback quickly? option A: revert route weight to previous; option B: fast patch to add defensive null-check in cache and restart auth pods.
Sam: +1 for patch, low risk. PR has tests. If we need faster, revert route.
Jorge: I'll prepare the revert if patch takes >15m. Also can we throttle burstpertenant in the gw to smooth spikes? small config tweak:
```yaml
rate_limit:
  per_tenant: 120rps
  burst: 30
```
Priya: @Liam can you attach the PR link and callout the exact line for null-check? I'll approve after quick review.
Liam: PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/4321 — change at auth/token_cache.go line 78: `if entry == nil { return cached, nil }` (added). Tests pass locally.
Maya: I'll watch logs and increase telemetry sampling for auth flows. if 429s persist after patch, we'll revert route at 01:05 UTC.
Sam: deploying patch to staging now. will post status.
Sam: staging patch ✅ auth pod restarted, no 429s in 10m window under synthetic load.
Priya: nice. will schedule canary rollout to 5% then 25% once green
Jorge: prepping the revert playbook just in case. ping me if you need a hand.
Priya: thanks team. small follow-ups: Sam — can you open a short runbook note about token-cache settings? Liam — squash the PR and add a tiny unit test for eviction race.
Liam: on it, will also add a TODO to revisit cache sizing.
Priya: OK signing off — catching sleep. ping on-call if anything spikes :zzz:
